title: Integral Distinguishers for 8-Round LED and Its Inverse
summary: Traditional bit-based division property cannot find an integral distinguisher for 8-round LED or its inverse; whether one exists outside that framework remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether 8-round LED or its inverse admits an integral distinguisher. Any such distinguisher cannot be found using the traditional bit-based division property, even with perfect Super-Sbox modeling and arbitrary linear masks applied to Super-Sbox inputs and outputs, so the existence question must be resolved outside that framework.

scope.domain: Integral cryptanalysis of 8-round LED and its inverse.
parameters: 8 rounds — fixed number of LED rounds under study
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether 8-round LED or its inverse admits an integral distinguisher outside the traditional bit-based division-property framework.

citations.label: Convexity of division property transitions: theory, algorithms and compact models

progress.summary: The source shows that traditional bit-based division property cannot find such a distinguisher, even with perfect Super-Sbox modeling and arbitrary input and output linear masks. It leaves the actual existence of a distinguisher unresolved.
citation_labels: Aleksei Udovenko et al., Convexity of division property transitions: theory, algorithms and compact models
